content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P0 - spike in 5xx and latency on prompt-router -> new-endpoint canary. Alerting on-call. See grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/prompt-router

alex (oncall): Ack. I'm taking the page. Starting triage. Paging @jamal for backend traces and @maya for release owner context.

jamal: I'm on traces. 5xx rate up to ~4.8% on /v1/prompt/new (baseline ~0.2%). Roughly 52% of errors are 502s coming from the new inference backend pool (inference-new-0/1).

alex (oncall): Good sleuthing. Initial mitigation: toggle the feature flag to route traffic back to stable prompt-router while we assess. Executing kill-switch now.

alex (oncall): ```bash
# kill switch - flip to stable route
rflag set prompt_use_new_endpoint false --env=prod --actor=alex --reason "P0 canary 502 spike"
```

ops-bot: Flag update: prompt_use_new_endpoint = false (actor=alex) at 2026-03-15T14:47:08Z. Routing policy updated: requests -> stable-prompt-router.

jamal: After the flip, 5xx dropped to ~0.4% within 90s. Latency tail improving. Looks like new endpoint was the immediate contributor.

maya: Support impact: we're seeing 12 fresh tickets referencing errors from experimental prompt flow in last 20m. Customer-facing comms needed. @rita can you draft a note?

rita (support): Drafting now. Proposed: "We've observed increased errors for customers using the experimental prompt routing feature. We've reverted traffic to the stable route and are monitoring. No action required on your side. We'll provide a follow-up with root-cause and timeline." Will share in #support-notifications for review.

jamal: Quick root-cause hypothesis: new endpoint's upstream timeout + an aggressive batching config caused long tails under certain input shapes; nginx returned 502 for queued requests when upstreams dropped. Collecting logs and config diffs.

alex (oncall): Handoff plan: I'm going to be on call for the next 15m to make sure metrics stabilize, then hand to @sylvia for the overnight watch. Please do not re-enable the canary until smoke tests pass in staging and an infra change (timeout/batching) is in place.

sylvia: Copy. I'll take the watch at +15. Confirming the feature flag is locked down. Will run a quick synthetic test run every 10m and report.

jamal: Logged follow-ups: (1) RFC for batching + timeout defaults on new-endpoint, (2) add canary guardrails to detect backend 5xx vs gateway 5xx, (3) postmortem once incident is closed.

alex (oncall): Action items assigned. Customer comms sent by Rita. Traffic is stable. Lowering severity.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to P1 — killer flag engaged and traffic reverted. Channel remains open for handoff and postmortem notes.

alex (oncall): I'll keep the thread open for 1h and then close if nothing else pops. Thanks everyone for the quick response. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Adding one note for the postmortem — correlate inputs that cause long compute with queue length; we saw a tight cluster at 14:40-14:46 that overwhelmed one backend pool.

rita (support): Support queue monitoring: no new critical customer escalations after rollback. Will reopen if anything changes.

sylvia: Taking watch. Will escalate if error rate creeps back above 0.5% for more than 2m.

alex (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing leadership notify: @maya, I'll sync for the postmortem doc later today.

incident-bot: Incident thread will be archived after close. Thanks team.
